required_behavior: P2-1: while waiting for the main child, the supervisor also reaps any other exited child (subreaper orphans) with non-blocking waitpid(-1) and emits the existing descendant-reaped event; main child handled on its own path; no zombie accumulation over long runs.

P2-2: OmpPane (and any other pane/session cleanup) must never signal a process/group whose identity is not proven: record OMP sid+start_ticks at spawn; before killing session members verify membership identity (start_ticks >= OMP start and same sid, or pidfd snapshot taken while identity was proven); if OMP already reaped and identity cannot be proven, skip scanning. Never kill foreign sessions (C-D45).
P2-3: reset SIGPIPE and SIGXFSZ to SIG_DFL before exec in all child paths (OmpPane, ShellProcess, supervisor experiment child) so user shell/experiments inherit default dispositions.

P2-4: manual foreground input: per-write target check must be cheap (TIOCGPGRP + leader stat; full session scan only when the foreground group changes), and ShellPane._flush must be bounded per pump iteration so a 2 MiB paste never blocks the backend loop (OMP output, control drain, UI requests, SIGTERM) for more than a short slice; keep all-or-nothing admission and per-write target re-validation semantics.
acceptance: red->green tests for each P2 (zombie count stays bounded with 50 double-fork orphans during a long main; PID-reuse simulation never signals a foreign session; child SigIgn lacks SIGPIPE/SIGXFSZ for shell, experiment, OMP; 2 MiB paste to a raw `cat` foreground completes while backend stays responsive e.g. UI status/snapshot latency < 1 s throughout)

all prior suites green: tests/terminal, tests/gates/g2_shell (PYTHONPATH=src:.), canonical matrix, tests/backend, tests/contracts, tests/lifecycle, tests/gates/g4_lifetime (PYTHONPATH=src:.), tests/workflow, tests/observation
stop_conditions: fix requires contract change or weakening automation holds/identity
